cc:Work.dc:title: Mismatch and the expert constraint
cc:Work.dc:description: Conceptual illustration. Left: expert and student distributions differ, while expert responses satisfy the shaded constraint. Right: zero out student probability outside the valid set and renormalize, preserving relative probabilities inside. Not experimental data.
